ZAR FILE FORMAT
===============

Block size: 8192 bytes.
Header size: 256 bytes.
Index entry size: 8 bytes.
Index entries per index block: 1024.

Layout
------
- The file begins with one or more index blocks.
- Each index block contains 1024 uint64 offsets.
- Each non-zero entry points to the first block of a stored record.
- A stored record starts with a 256-byte header in the first block.
- Continuation blocks have no header and store raw payload bytes only.

Payload
-------
Payload stored for each record is:
    title bytes + binary data bytes

Header fields
-------------
uint64_t m_nextBlock
uint64_t m_prevBlock
uint64_t m_blockCount
uint64_t m_timestamp
uint64_t m_id
uint64_t m_flags
uint64_t m_counters[14]
uint8_t  m_checksum[64]
uint8_t  m_additional[16]
uint64_t m_dataLength
uint32_t m_titleLength
uint32_t m_extra
uint8_t  m_reserved[4]

Checksum
--------
Checksum is a simple xor-based rolling checksum across 64-bit chunks of
(title + data) using eight constant 64-bit seeds. The resulting 8 x 64-bit
state is stored as 64 bytes.

Selection APIs
--------------
Each Select* method returns JSON. The buffer-based methods stream the JSON in
chunks, similar to repeated read() calls. Repeated calls with the same query
continue where the previous call stopped until 0 bytes are returned.

JSON file APIs
--------------
The *ToJsonFile methods write the same JSON document to the specified path, or
an automatically generated temporary path in /tmp or %TEMP%/C:\Temp.

Extraction
----------
ExtractOne and ExtractAll write the binary payload only, using the title as the
relative path / file name under the specified extraction directory.
